content: Dɑfidi u win tɔmbu ɡɑrɑ
Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ mɑɑ Isirelibɑ mɔru kuɑ too, mɑ u derɑ Dɑfidi u bu seesi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ ɡɑri.

Yerɑ u Yoɑbu win tɑbu sunɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ win turuku sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ Isirelibɑn bwesenu kpuro berɑ sɑɑ tem mɛn sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di sere mɛn sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrɔ, kpɑ ɑ bu ɡɑri. Nɡe mɛyɑ kon kɑ ɡiɑ mɛ̀n nɔɔ bɑ ɡeeru nɛ.
Yoɑbu u sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni u de tɔn ben dɑbiru tu sosi wunɔm wunɔm subenu n kere yellu, kpɑ u mɑɑ de ɑ bu wɑ kɑ nɔni. Adɑmɑ mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ kĩ ɑ yeni ko.
Kɑ mɛ, sinɑ boko u Yoɑbu ɡɑri kɑmiɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ tɑbu sinɑm be bɑ tie. Mɑ Yoɑbu kɑ tɑbu sinɑm be, bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Isirelibɑ ɡɑrɑ.
Bɑ dɑ bɑ Yuudɛni tɔburɑ mɑ bɑ ben kunu ɡirɑ Aroɛɛn sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrɔ, wɔwɑɔ. Mɑ bɑ Gɑdin tem bukiɑnɑ bɑ dɑ Yɑsɛɛ ɡiɑ.
Min di, bɑ dɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ, kɑ Kɑdɛsiɔ Hɛtibɑn temɔ, kɑ Dɑnu Yɑniɔ kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnɔ kɑ Sidoniɔ,
kɑ Tiriɔ ye yɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ dɑmɡiru mɔ, kɑ wuu si su rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Hefibɑ kɑ Kɑnɑnibɑɡisɔ, n kɑ ɡirɑri Beri Sebɑɔ, Yudɑn tem sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kuɑ bɑ kɑ tem mɛ kpuro bukiɑnɑ. Mɑ n kuɑ suru nɔɔbɑ nnɛ kɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛndu bɑ sere tunumɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.

Ye bɑ tunumɑ sinɑ bokon mi, mɑ Yoɑbu u nùn tɔn ben ɡeeru sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U nɛɛ, Isirelibɑ sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu kowobu bɑ kɑ tɑkobi sɑnnɔ yɛ̃, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɛnɛ (800.000). Yudɑn bweseru sɔɔ mɑɑ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɛɛrɑ wunɔbu (500.000).
Gusunɔ u Dɑfidi sɛɛyɑsiɑ
win torɑrun sɔ̃
Ye Dɑfidi u nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ win torɑrɑ kɑrɑ, mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ torɑ n kpɑ̃ ye nɑ kɑ tɔn be ɡɑrɑ. Tɛ̃ nɑ ɡiɑ mɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑ kookoosɑ nɑ kuɑ. A mɑn nɛn torɑ ten suuru kuo.

Sɑɑ yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u win sɔmɔ Gɑdi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ Dɑfidi sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡerumɔ. Wee, nɑ nùn nɔni swɑ̃ɑru itɑ ɡɑɑ yiiye. Yen sɔ̃, u de u ɡɔsimɑ ten te u kĩ kpɑ n sere de tu koorɑ. Sisiru bururu ye Dɑfidi u seewɑ,

Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Gɑdi u dɑ win mi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, yen yerɑ̀ ɑ kĩ. Gɔ̃ɔru tu du wunɛn tem sɔɔ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru? Nɡe ɑ kpikiru su suru itɑ wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑn sɔ̃. Nɡe bɑrɑru ɡɑru tu pusi wunɛn tem sɔɔ sɔ̃ɔ itɑ. Tɛ̃, ɑ bwisikuo kpɑ ɑ mɑn sɔ̃ ye kon dɑ n wi u mɑn ɡɔrimɑ sɔ̃.
Yerɑ Dɑfidi u Gɑdi wisɑ u nɛɛ, nuku sɑnkirɑ bɑkɑnɑ nu mɑn deemɑ mi. N burɑm bo Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn sɛɛyɑsiɑ ye tɔnu koo kɑ mɑn sɛɛyɑsiɑ. Domi win wɔnwɔndɑ kpɑ̃.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ bɑrɑrɑ pusi sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten bururun di n kɑ ɡirɑri sɔ̃ɔ itɑ ye. Mɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkuru (70.000) bɑ ɡbisukɑ Isirelin tem kpuro sɔɔ.

Sɑɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo u sɔɔru kpɑ u kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu kpeerɑsiɑ, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ u wɑhɑlɑ bɑkɑ ye yɔ̃rɑsiɑ. Mɑ u ɡɔrɑdo wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ turɑ mɛ. A wunɛn nɔmɑ wĩɔ minin di. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, ɡɔrɑdo wi, u wɑ̃ɑwɑ Arɑfunɑ Yebusin doo soo yerun bɔkuɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Dɑfidi u ɡɔrɑdo wi wɑ wi u tɔmbu ɡoomɔ yerɑ u nɛɛ, nɛnɑ nɑ tore. Tɔn beni bɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ de ɑ mɑn nɔmɑ doke nɛ kɑ nɛn yɛnuɡibu.
Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ
yɑ̃ku yeru bɑniɑ
Yen dɔmɑ terɑ Gɑdi u dɑ Dɑfidin mi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku yeru kuo Arɑfunɑ Yebusin doo soo yeru mi.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Gɑdin ɡɑri yi wurɑ. U kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U dɑ mi.
Yerɑ Arɑfunɑ u mɛɛrɑ ɡunɡuru wɔllun di u wɑ wee, sinɑ boko kɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu bɑ wee, yerɑ u sɑrɑmɑ kɑ dukɑ u dɑ u nùn yiirɑ u wuswɑɑ tem ɡirɑri.

Mɑ u Dɑfidi bikiɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, mbɑ n kuɑ ɑ kɑ sisi nɛn mi. Dɑfidi u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nɑwɑ n kɑ wunɛn doo soo yee te dwe kpɑ n Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku yeru bɑniɑ mi. Kpɑ bɑrɑ te tɑ pusɑ bɛsɛn tem sɔɔ mi, tu doonɑ.
Yerɑ Arɑfunɑ u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ bɑtumɑ ye suo kɑm, kpɑ ɑ yɑ̃kunu ko mi, ni ɑ kĩ. Kɛtɛbɑ wee, yi kɑɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru ko, kpɑ yin suɡu kɑ yin kɛkɛbɑn dɑ̃nu nu ko yɑ̃ku dɑ̃ɑ.
Ye kpurowɑ durɔ wi, u sinɑ boko kɑ̃, mɑ u mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni, u kɑ nun nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛri.

Adɑmɑ sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, ɑɑwo, kon bɑtumɑ ye dwewɑ kɑ nɛn ɡobi. Nɑ ǹ Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru kuɑmmɛ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ni nu ǹ mɑn ɡɑ̃ɑnu diiri. Mɑ Dɑfidi u bɑtumɑ ye kɑ kɛtɛ be dwɑ kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi weerɑɑkuru.
Mɑ u yɑ̃ku yee te kuɑ bɑtumɑ mi. U yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kuɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu. Sɑɑ yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔn mɔru yɑ sure. Mɑ bɑrɑ te, tɑ doonɑ tem min di.
